_comment: Plugin-shipped hooks for komdosh-dev-infra-core. Auto-loaded by Claude Code when this plugin is installed. The script reads the hook input as JSON from stdin and emits the Claude Code JSON output protocol on stdout (hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) — the only exit-0 channel the model actually sees. It advises, never blocks, and exits 0 in every path. Silent no-op in non-infra repos.
